summary.title: Home layout v2: Liquid Glass and updated bottom chrome
changes: Home panels use a real Liquid Glass appearance on iOS 26, with a material fallback on older iOS devices.
Adjustment cards, multi-use/TIR banners, and bolus progress share a common glass chrome and show a two-color rim when a.
The bottom tab bar is icon-only on iOS 26 and has a centered floating treatment button that opens the treatment sheet (.
The floating treatment button stays centered and no longer shifts when the keyboard or safe-area insets change.
Chart minimum height is reduced so the home layout fits on smaller iPhones with the taller iOS 26 tab bar.
